mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_STATUS, MEMBER_ID, DELIVERY_NAME, DELIVERY_PHONE, DELIVERY_POST_CODE, DELIVERY_ADDRESS, DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDRESS, DELIVERY_MESSAGE, TOTAL_AMOUNT, DELIVERY_FEE, PAYMENT_METHOD, IS_GIFT, GIFT_FROM_MEMBER_ID, GIFT_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, SYSDATE, NVL(#{orderStatus}, 'PENDING'), #{memberId}, #{deliveryName}, #{deliveryPhone}, #{deliveryPostCode}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{deliveryDetailAddress}, #{deliveryMessage}, #{totalAmount}, NVL(#{deliveryFee}, 0), #{paymentMethod}, NVL(#{isGift}, 'N'), #{giftFromMemberId}, #{giftMessage} )
INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM ( ORDER_ITEM_ID, ORDER_ID, PROD_NUM, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, QUANTITY ) VALUES ( SEQ_ORDER_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{orderId}, #{prodNum}, #{prodName}, #{prodPrice}, #{quantity} )
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID AS orderId, ORDER_DATE AS orderDate, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, DELIVERY_NAME AS deliveryName, DELIVERY_PHONE AS deliveryPhone, DELIVERY_POST_CODE AS deliveryPostCode, DELIVERY_ADDRESS AS deliveryAddress, DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDRESS AS deliveryDetailAddress, DELIVERY_MESSAGE AS deliveryMessage, TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFee, PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, IS_GIFT AS isGift, GIFT_FROM_MEMBER_ID AS giftFromMemberId, GIFT_MESSAGE AS giftMessage FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT ORDER_ITEM_ID AS orderItemId, ORDER_ID AS orderId, PROD_NUM AS prodNum, PROD_NAME AS prodName, PROD_PRICE AS prodPrice, QUANTITY AS quantity FROM ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY ORDER_ITEM_ID

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_DATE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.MEMBER_ID, O.DELIVERY_NAME, O.DELIVERY_PHONE, O.DELIVERY_POST_CODE, O.DELIVERY_ADDRESS, O.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDRESS, O.DELIVERY_MESSAGE, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.PAYMENT_METHOD, O.IS_GIFT, O.GIFT_FROM_MEMBER_ID, O.GIFT_MESSAGE, OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID, OI.PROD_NUM, OI.PROD_NAME, OI.PROD_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC, OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_DATE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.MEMBER_ID, O.DELIVERY_NAME, O.DELIVERY_PHONE, O.DELIVERY_POST_CODE, O.DELIVERY_ADDRESS, O.DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDRESS, O.DELIVERY_MESSAGE, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.PAYMENT_METHOD, O.IS_GIFT, O.GIFT_FROM_MEMBER_ID, O.GIFT_MESSAGE, OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID, OI.PROD_NUM, OI.PROD_NAME, OI.PROD_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE O.IS_GIFT = 'Y' AND O.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC, OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET DELIVERY_NAME = #{deliveryName}, DELIVERY_PHONE = #{deliveryPhone}, DELIVERY_POST_CODE = #{deliveryPostCode}, DELIVERY_ADDRESS = #{deliveryAddress}, DELIVERY_DETAIL_ADDRESS = #{deliveryDetailAddress}, DELIVERY_MESSAGE = #{deliveryMessage} WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
